# Entre Cafés Colombianos

> Colombian green and roasted coffee exporter based in Bogotá, Colombia. Registered coffee
> exporter with the Colombian Coffee Growers Federation (FNC).
> Founded 2026. Sells to roasters, importers, distributors and traders worldwide — from
> 250 g samples to 20' containers. English and Spanish.

## What we sell
- Specialty green coffee: Excelso, European Preparation (EP), screen 14+, 100% Arabica
  (predominantly Castillo; Colombia, Caturra, Bourbon, Tabi by lot), fully washed,
  84+ SCA points cupped by a certified Q-Grader, moisture 10–12%, density 750–800 g/L.
  Cup: panela / sugarcane sweetness, mandarin-orange acidity, creamy body, floral; caramel,
  milk chocolate and red fruits in the roast.
- Commercial green coffee: Excelso / UGQ preparation, screen 14+, SCA 80–83, for blends
  and private label. Priced against the market differential.
- Microlots on request: single-farm, Bourbon, honey or natural process, by pre-order.
- Roasted coffee (whole bean or ground): roasted to order in Bogotá, medium (Agtron 55–65)
  or medium-high (45–55); 250 g, 500 g, 1 kg vacuum bags with valve; wholesale 5–25 kg;
  private label available. Shipped 1–5 days after roasting.
- Sales inside Colombia: roasted and ground coffee for cafés, offices and companies.

## Current cup profiles (31 October 2026, green coffee)
- Huila (Acevedo, 1,580 masl), Supremo, SCA 86+: citrus, panela, floral, aromatic; washed,
  48 h fermentation in the cherry and 48 h after pulping, dried 10–12 days.
- Selecto (Huila, Cauca, Valle del Cauca, Quindío blend), Excelso EP, SCA 84+ by Q-Grader:
  sugarcane, panela, mandarin, orange, creamy body, floral; mainly Castillo, screen 14+.
- Tolima, washed Castillo, UGQ export grade, 81.82: cocoa, panela, sugarcane, chocolate,
  caramel, medium citrus acidity; moisture 10–12%.
- Basic (Nariño, 1,650–1,800 masl), cup score 77.0 (cupping sheet of 10 Sep 2026): mandarin,
  rose honey, jasmine, red fruits, figs, lemongrass, green-grape acidity, caramel finish.
- Full profiles: https://www.entrecafescolombianos.coffee/cup-profiles

## Where the coffee comes from
Huila (reference profile), Cauca, Valle del Cauca, Nariño, Quindío; also Tolima, Risaralda
(Pereira) and the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta (seasonal). Altitude 1,500–1,900+ masl.
Main harvest September–December, secondary (mitaca) April–June; Cauca peaks April–July.

## Shipment sizes and logistics
- Samples: 250 g – 1 kg per profile by DHL Express.
- Courier lots: 10–60 kg green or 10–50 kg roasted per shipment (FNC small-quantity
  regime), DHL Express door to door (DAP your address), 5–8 business days worldwide.
- Pallets: 100–1,000 kg by consolidated air cargo or LCL sea freight.
- Containers: 20' FCL = 275 bags × 70 kg ≈ 19.25 t; half container = 10 t (143 bags).
  Mixed green/roasted loads possible.
- Incoterms 2020: DAP your address (courier lots), EXW / FCA Bogotá, FOB Cartagena or
  Santa Marta, CFR / CIF destination.
- Ports of loading: Cartagena (Contecar) or Santa Marta. Sea transit 18–35 days.
- Lead time: courier lots 1–2 weeks from payment; containers typically 4–6 weeks.
- Packaging: 70 kg fique/jute bags with GrainPro-type hermetic liner; 35 kg bags and
  1,000 kg big bags on request. Bags marked with lot, origin, net weight, crop year and ICO marks.

## Pricing and payment
- Containers: New York "C" contract plus an agreed differential, fixed at contract date,
  FOB Cartagena or CIF. Indicative FOB Cartagena price for a 20' container (100–275 bags of
  70 kg) in the online estimator; firm price in a dated offer sheet.
- Courier lots: per kilogram, freight as its own line. Instant indicative estimate (coffee +
  packing + DHL Express freight, DAP, in USD) for the United States, Spain, Germany, France,
  the Netherlands, Belgium, Sweden, Poland and the UAE at
  https://www.entrecafescolombianos.coffee/shipping-estimate — other countries on request.
- Payment: samples and courier lots in advance by bank transfer; containers with a deposit
  on contract and balance against documents, or confirmed letter of credit. Invoiced in USD.

## Documents and compliance
- With every shipment: commercial invoice (DIAN electronic), packing list, B/L or AWB,
  ICO certificate of origin, lot data sheet and signed Q-Grader cupping sheet, Almacafé
  quality certificate and FNC transit guide (containers), insurance certificate under CIF.
- EU: green coffee enters at 0% duty with no phytosanitary certificate required (outside
  Annex XI of Regulation (EU) 2019/2072). Roasted coffee 7.5% MFN or 0% with the EU–Colombia
  origin declaration, which we issue. Phytosanitary certificate (ICA) issued when another
  destination requires it.
- EUDR: we are building plot-level geolocation with our suppliers for EU-bound lots and state
  on every offer sheet whether a lot has farm geolocation. No lot is sold as EUDR-ready
  unless the data exists.
- INVIMA sanitary registration NSA-0006451-2019 (roasted products). Coffee is never fumigated.

## Markets
Shipped: Sweden; Colombia (domestic). Quoted / active enquiries: Belgium, Spain,
Netherlands, Germany, United States, South Africa, Namibia, United Arab Emirates, Israel,
Saudi Arabia.
